notes: OPPO prefixes every size/weight with 'about'. oppo.com/cn (also a primary domain) prints the same numbers without 约: 高 展开：166.4 毫米，折叠：85.5 毫米 / 宽 展开：75.8 毫米，折叠：75.8 毫米 / 厚 展开：7.79 毫米，折叠：16.45 毫米 / 重量 198 克 — kept OPPO's precision, nothing rounded. Height/width/thickness are three separate spec rows, so each dimension gets its own leaf source entry. announced = the date in OPPO's own global-launch press release; the China debut page https://www.oppo.com/cn/events/find-n3-flip-launch/ says only '8月29日 14:30，与你相见' with NO year printed, so I did not convert it into a date. released left null: the press release states only 'Pre-orders of OPPO Find N3 Series start from October 20, 2023', a pre-order date, not a release date. hinge.crease: OPPO's product page calls it a 'waterdrop design' hinge -> teardrop. free_stop: FlexForm holds between 45-120 degrees; that is a hold range, NOT a maximum hinge angle, so max_angle_deg stays null. panel recorded as OLED to match the SPEC enum; OPPO's literal wording is 'AMOLED (flexible)', stated once for the device rather than per screen. materials.frame/back NOT stated on either OPPO spec page — left null (the press release's 'Champagne Gold (glass back), and Classic Black (vegan leather back)' belongs to the Find N3, a DIFFERENT model, and was deliberately not carried over). 'Screen Ratio 85.9%' is screen-to-body, not display aspect, so aspect is null; the cover screen's 17:9 ratio appears only on secondary sites — left null. controls left empty (not surveyed). || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'flip'; hinge.axis = 'short'.
